title: Love the concept, just wish it could have been executed better.
text: Love the concept, just wish it could have been executed better.. I love Christmas. And not because of the gift giving, but the time spent with family and beautiful holiday decorations. I love the gorgeous trees, the wreaths, rows of garland, and the Christmas lights. With that in mind, I thought pre-lit garland (by Kvdukoa) would be a nice addition to my decorations. And it is kind of. Let me explain. What I liked: This garland comes decorated with red berries and miniature pine-cones. It is also pre-lit with tiny white lights. It is battery operated, so there are no cords or wires. It is long enough (9ft) so can be placed it on the fireplace mantel or along top of your front door. What I didn’t like or an unsure of: While decorated, it doesn’t have enough lights or decorations. It could have used a lot more of each. I ended up adding additional red berries, but it would have been nicer had it come with more. The pine-cones are small, so adding some more would have made it more festive. Another thing that I will add is that you should secure the garland wherever you place it. Initially I placed the garland on the mantel of our fireplace. But one day something made it fall, breaking the battery compartment. My husband was able to reassemble but had to tape it shut. Fortunately for me, it still works, but I learned a valuable lesson – you definitely need to secure it. With all that being said, this garland is pretty but needs more. I give it 3 stars.
